question: What definition of 1C is used, and what share of theoretical capacity is reached on the first discharge at 0.1C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE kind IN ('line','cell') AND (text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%theoretical%' OR text ILIKE '%0.1C%' OR text ILIKE '%C rate%' OR text ILIKE '%current density%') ORDER BY page, id
